source: User-supplied Coinwise/K1m6a screenshots, visually inspected; not an independently verified live feed

observed.price_path: Successive declining right-edge candles continue below the previously watched 78400 area toward 78100. No completed reversal base or held reclaim is visible.
observed.cvd_path: The earlier advance in CVD has flattened, with a small retreat from its local peak. No distinct new reversal-confirming surge is evident at the right edge.
observed.oi_path: OI declines along consecutive right-edge bars from its local peak above 18.4B to 17.96B.

previous_event.comparison_limit: Tick size, price-profile labels and visual paths match, but exact contract, timestamps, indicator sources, settings and CVD anchor remain unverified. Label arithmetic is not a measured money flow, new-position count or perfectly synchronized interval comparison. Identical rounded CVD readings do not prove zero intervening delta.

assessment.interpretation: The pullback continues despite declining OI and a relatively flat displayed CVD. This is compatible with net position reduction, not proof of a completed long flush, strong absorption or an imminent bottom. Net OI cannot identify the initiating side; USD valuation changes may affect a dollar-denominated OI series. Flat aggregate CVD does not prove an absence of sellers.
assessment.default_action: WAIT_FOR_PRICE_CONFIRMATION; no blind market long or averaging ladder justified by this screenshot

lower_zone_observation.requirements: Observe whether price stops making local lows, forms a base or sweep/reclaim, and improves on a retest while CVD stabilizes. A touch alone is not confirmation.

long_repair.early_repair_observation: Return above approximately 78400 and hold a retest would show initial structural repair, not automatically trigger an entry.
long_repair.preserved_stronger_confirmation: The prior 78600-78650 reclaim plus held retest remains the stronger repair gate. Do not lower this gate merely because price fell further.
long_repair.invalidation: Any separately confirmed entry must have a predefined retest-low invalidation honored regardless of the OI direction.

short_failed_recovery.trigger: A later rebound into a broken area fails, price forms a local lower high and CVD weakens over the same interval.
short_failed_recovery.risk_gate: Do not chase the current extended downswing toward nearby lower reference levels. Require an explicit stop and sufficient reward relative to risk after fees and slippage.

quality_risk_and_privacy.source_price_warning: Main chart 78100 differs from tape near 78000. The tape is not a verified MEXC quote; do not transfer reference levels to executable orders using an assumed fixed offset.
quality_risk_and_privacy.liquidation_warning: Right-edge labels refer to an unknown interval, not cumulative session totals. A smaller later long-liquidation label does not establish that liquidation pressure ended. Minus is plotting direction. Do not add the moving average to liquidation volume.

learning_summary: Falling OI did not prevent the visible continuation lower; never label it automatically constructive for longs.
An unchanged rounded CVD reading is not proof of absent selling or buy-side absorption.
Watch zones, triggered entries and executed positions must remain separate.
Preserve prior triggers and invalidation; do not move the goalposts to each lower support.
Price-based risk limits must not require a simultaneous OI increase.
A profitable later bounce would not retrospectively validate an unconfirmed entry.

methodology_sources_checked.scope: OI counts outstanding contracts; each has a buyer and seller, counted once. Not a source of screenshot readings.
General OI definition, not Coinwise aggregation verification.
CVD accumulation and anchor dependence; does not identify Coinwise settings.
